preconditions.description: The length of the binary representation of r is between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: len(l_binary) == n and all(c in '01' for c in l_binary)
preconditions.description: The binary string for l has exactly n characters, all 0 or 1.

preconditions.expression: len(r_binary) == n and all(c in '01' for c in r_binary) and r_binary[0] == '1'
preconditions.description: The binary string for r has exactly n characters, all 0 or 1, with no leading zeros (unless r=0).
The integer value of l is less than or equal to the integer value of r.

postconditions.description: The output is the binary representation of the maximum g(x, y) for l ≤ x ≤ y ≤ r, without leading zeros (unless the result is 0).

postconditions.expression: max_g == max(g(x, y) for x in range(int(l_binary, 2), int(r_binary, 2) + 1) for y in range(x, int(r_binary, 2) + 1))
postconditions.description: The computed max_g is the maximum value of g(x, y) for all valid x and y in the range [l, r].
